forecasts.name: The duty spreads
forecasts.outcome: the share of design postings asking for either duty at least doubles: from 19.6% on 30 October 2026 to 39.3%, and from 17.8% to 35.7% without whichever company posts the most of them.
forecasts.wrong_if: the October 2028 count misses either threshold.
forecasts.context: "Either duty" is judging what AI makes, or setting the rules it works to. The postings are those on the 80 public job boards the piece counts.

forecasts.name: The job gets a name
forecasts.outcome: at least 5 design postings on these boards have a title naming the work: evaluation or evals, quality, QA, guardrails, model or AI behaviour, or a design system for AI. None did on 30 October 2026.
forecasts.wrong_if: the October 2028 count finds fewer than 5.
forecasts.context: "These boards" are the 80 public job boards the piece counts. Reviewed with The duty spreads, from the same piece.

forecasts.name: Design systems add agent-surface patterns
forecasts.outcome: at least two of six major public design systems — IBM Carbon, GOV.UK, USWDS, Apple HIG, Shopify Polaris, or Stripe's public design/docs system — publish an explicit pattern or specification for agent-consumed / headless product surfaces alongside human screens.
forecasts.wrong_if: fewer than two of those six have published one by 31 December 2028.
forecasts.context: Checked against the public documentation of those six named design and developer systems.

forecasts.piece_title: Why "Are you sure?" modals fail agents: the reversibility matrix for speculative UI
forecasts.name: Agent protocols ship per-tool reversibility and blast-radius routing
forecasts.outcome: at least two of six major agentic developer or protocol ecosystems — Model Context Protocol (MCP), Anthropic Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Windsurf — ship a declarative per-tool reversibility and blast-radius field (beyond a single boolean readOnlyHint or destructiveHint) that UI clients use to route reversible workspace mutations into preview diffs without modal prompts while keeping hard confirmation on external calls.
forecasts.wrong_if: fewer than two ship such schema-driven routing by 31 December 2028.
forecasts.context: Checked against official public protocol specifications and client documentation of MCP, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Windsurf.

forecasts.piece_title: Why turning reasoning effort down rescued my flagship audit
forecasts.name: Major API platforms cap reasoning tokens separately from visible output
forecasts.outcome: at least two of four major API platforms — OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google Vertex/AI Studio — expose a documented request parameter that caps reasoning tokens, where reasoning tokens do not count against the visible-output cap (so a reasoning burst cannot shorten the visible answer).
forecasts.wrong_if: fewer than two of those four expose such a parameter by 31 December 2027.
forecasts.context: Checked against official public API request documentation of OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Vertex/AI Studio.
